answer_1.quote: In human-bot conversations, it is crucial to generate stylistic responses for increasing user engagement to conversational systems.

answer_2.quote: Automatic Evaluation ... we report the average probability of responses being positive as a measurement of the style intensity. For brevity, we denote this metric as SI. The content relevance is evaluated by BLEU. ... we evaluate the diversity by Dist-k.

answer_3.quote: we fine-tune a BERT ... as the style classifier ... we report the average probability of responses being positive as a measurement of the style intensity.

answer_4.quote: Human Evaluation We randomly sample 200 messages from the test set of C to conduct the human evaluation from two aspects: style intensity and content relevance. Each aspect is independently evaluated by five Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT) workers ...
answer_4.guideline: Workers are asked to give a preference of which one is better in style intensity and content relevance (ties permitted).
